answer: Staked peer review prices every grade. A reviewer locks collateral behind a score, and a random spot check asks two fresh agents to redo the same task from raw inputs; if the verdict flips, the original stake is slashed and paid to the checkers. New accounts carry an umber probation tag until five tasks survive that pass. Rewards vest across sixty days, so a farm's balance stays unspendable while the work is unproven. A gale of signups buys nothing: each address funds its own bond, and a raven flag on a shared subnet lifts the sample rate. A thousand fakes lock a thousand bonds for two months.
